text:
jana_sales: Heads-up: VitalGrid sent an RFI asking for a hybrid privacy model. Requirements: EU data residency, customer-managed HSM, PII must be redacted at collection OR a cryptographic attestation that plaintext never left their VPC. They also want a capability matrix, a 2-week POC plan demonstrating a streaming messaging pipeline, and a preliminary cost schedule by next Wed. Can SE/SRE scope?

omar_se: Got it. Can you paste the exact RFI line and link? Need to know whether deterministic tokenization is required for search/matching.

jana_sales: Link: https://vitalgrid.example/rfi/vitalgrid-2026.pdf. Excerpt: "All personal identifiers must be removed or irreversibly tokenized at point of collection. Where tokenization is infeasible, vendor must provide cryptographic proof (signed audit bundle) that plaintext never left the customer network and that HSM key material was never accessible to the vendor."

rita_sre: Two realistic paths: (A) client-side tokenization SDK + Redwood Private in EU (shortest path), (B) Private in-customer VPC with HSM broker where unwrapping happens only on-customer-host, (C) fully on-prem appliance for zero vendor access. Option B requires peering and an in-VPC unwrap service; Option C is heavy.

omar_se: I'll add a fourth row: (D) privacy-preserving inference using local quantized runtime in their subnet for sensitive fields and hybrid callout for non-sensitive parts. This is more engineering but may satisfy their auditors.

evan_pricing: Preliminary placeholders: POC (2w) fixed $16k, Dedicated EU small $7.2k/mo, Private install one-time $52k + $8.5k/mo, On-prem appliance +$110k. For the local-quant runtime add-on suggest +20% engineering fee. Mark all as draft.

priya_legal: Legal note: if VitalGrid insists on vendor having zero access to unwrapped keys, contractually that is an on-prem deployment. We must add language on certification of key handling, responsibilities for key rotation, and a data-deletion attestation after POC. Also ask if they accept SOC2 + pen-test or require extra artifacts.

omar_se: POC deliverables for matrix (short bullets): 1) streaming demo for messaging with tokenization flow, 2) attachment-redaction pipeline demo, 3) throughput smoke at 120 rps (small messages) and 30 rps with 10KB attachments, 4) signed audit bundle for sampled traces proving no plaintext egress, 5) ops runbook for HSM proxy and emergency key revoke.

rita_sre: Provisioning ETA: once we have CIDRs and peering contacts, 24-72h to provision Redwood Private proxies in their EU region. For on-prem appliance plan 2-3 weeks plus travel for install. Firewall snippet for runbook:```
# Example VPC peering rules
allow tcp 443 from vitalgrid-admin to redwood-eu-proxy:443
allow tcp 10250-10255 from redwood-control to vitalgrid-admin
```

omar_se: Tiny SDK snippet for client-side tokenization we can drop in the matrix:```js
// tokenization before send
const tokenized = tokenizeFields(payload, ['ssn','dob','name']);
await sendToRedwoodPrivate({body: encrypt(tokenized, envelopeKey)});
```

attachments-bot: uploaded "vitalgrid-rfi.pdf" and "vitalgrid-capability-matrix-draft.csv" (internal links).

jana_sales: VitalGrid asked specifically about SLAs: they want 99.95% for Dedicated and a POC uptime commitment with data-deletion certification. Can pricing/legal confirm if we can accept 99.95% for Dedicated or suggest 99.9%?

evan_pricing: Default Dedicated SLA is 99.9% in our standard terms. 99.95% is possible at premium — suggest +10% on monthly or a higher support tier. I'll confirm numbers with pricing ops and put a note in the matrix.

priya_legal: Also flag that data-deletion certification after POC requires agreed evidence format. Suggest we offer signed certificate + sample scrub logs. Add to matrix as requirement.

omar_se: Action items: Omar - update capmatrix with A/B/C/D options + POC deliverables and SLA row by Tue EOD. Rita - provide provisioning ETA + appliance install timeline and firewall snippets by Tue noon. Evan - validate draft pricing and SLA premium with pricing ops by Tue afternoon. Priya - review RFI contractual asks and draft clause language for key custody and deletion attestation. Jana - set a 30-min security sync with VitalGrid for Wed 9am CET.

jana_sales: On it. I'll invite their security lead and our SE/SRE/legal. :thumbsup:

omar_se: On the sync. I'll bring a short decision guide (risk vs latency vs cost) for each approach.

rita_sre: I'll prepare a short runbook excerpt for the call showing key rotation steps and emergency revoke.

jana_sales: Thanks team — will follow up after the sync.
